Lithium-ion Battery.reasoning: Cathode material in high energy density batteries, standard but with some substitution possibilities.

Lithium-ion Battery.name: Copper
Lithium-ion Battery.reasoning: Essential conductor for internal current collection, universally used across battery types.

Lithium-ion Battery.name: Aluminum
Lithium-ion Battery.reasoning: Used in cathode current collectors and battery casing, industry standard material.

Lithium-ion Battery.name: Graphite
Lithium-ion Battery.reasoning: Anode material supporting lithium-ion intercalation, ubiquitous in commercial lithium-ion batteries.

Display Panel.name: Indium

Display Panel.name: Gallium
Display Panel.reasoning: Used in compound semiconductors for LED backlights or display components, standard but alternatives exist.

Display Panel.name: Aluminum
Display Panel.reasoning: Materials for structural elements, frame, and heat spreaders common but some plastic alternatives exist.

Display Panel.name: Silicon
Display Panel.reasoning: Core semiconductor used in display drivers and control integrated circuits, essential for functionality.
